Each screen mode learns separately. The charge model can start after three usable intervals, two minutes of observation and 0.1% equivalent consumption. The percentage model needs six clean 1% drops. Either can supply the widget while the other learns. Sensor resolution and everyday use determine how long this takes.

Import replaces both histories; older backups restore percentage history only. Use a backup from this phone for relevant estimates.

Two parallel models in 5% bands, with a 14-day half-life and eight-week limit. Percentage samples measure full 1% drops; counter samples measure µAh consumed between events and close at state transitions. The counter model approximates full-charge scale as remaining µAh / system charge fraction; this is not a battery-health measurement. Rates are weighted by elapsed time, not event count. Blend scores use consumed amount, recency, coverage, days and variability, with an additional counter-calibration penalty. Scores are heuristic, not accuracy probabilities; both models share gauge data. Coverage requires three effective percentage points on two days. Charging, screen-off audio, unknown audio, counter resets and implausible windows are excluded. Voltage/current/temperature are diagnostic; no voltage-to-percentage curve is assumed. Cached voltage/temperature may predate a screen event. Audio reports and counter resolution depend on the device.
